parameters.name: CheckIds
parameters.description:
The ID of the check item.

> You can call the [DescribeRiskType](~~DescribeRiskType~~) operation to obtain the check item ID.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: RiskId
parameters.description:
The ID of the baseline.

> You can call the [DescribeCheckWarningSummary](~~116179~~) operation to obtain the baseline ID.
